KEN.note: The Act amends a cybercrime law and does not name AI.
The Act is a cybercrime law amendment; it names no national response body, strategy, incident or critical infrastructure.

facts.fact: Kenya's Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes (Amendment) Act, 2025 (No. 17 of 2025), assented 15 October 2025 and commencing 4 November 2025, amends the Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, Cap. 79C.
facts.system: Computer Misuse and Cybercrimes Act, Cap. 79C

KEN.note: The Act concerns computer misuse and cybercrime, not payment providers or e-money.
